name: Sentry
description: Error tracking and performance monitoring platform for developers to diagnose, fix, and optimize their code.

evidence.claim: Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically to manage organizations, teams, and data.

notes: Sentry provides robust API support with OAuth2 authorization code grant flow, token-based authentication via internal integrations or user personal tokens, and regional base domains.
